en: I can appreciate your talent as a pop idol.
Under different circumstances, I'd be rooting for your career.
But I can't afford to care about that right now.
I'll do it. But if I give you the letter...
You have to promise to leave us alone forever.
Hmm. I can't promise we'll never run into each other again.
The entertainment industry is a small world, after all.

But if you can't put on a smile when we cross paths, you'll
never make it in this business.
That's the nature of the industry. Surely you knew that.

Come to platform 23 of Shin-Osaka Station... You can give me
the letter there.
Shin-Osaka Station?
Yes, my schedule has me quite tied up at the moment.
I apologize, but I'm afraid I need you to come to me.

Oh, and one more thing. Come alone. I will do the same, of
course.
Will you really?
You have my word. All right, I'll be waiting.
Haruka! You're awake!
Any word?
No, nothing. The police haven't contacted us yet, either.
I see... Damn it!
Akiyama-san, what's going on? Who were those guys?

They were from a crime family called Ousaka Enterprises.
Said they're after a letter Park-san received from her
ex-husband.
They think Haruka-chan has it.
All that for a letter?

Wait. Is Ousaka Enterprises responsible for Park-san and
Horie-kun, too?
Unbelievable.
Isn't there anything we can do? I can't stand this.

We don't have a single clue as to where she is... There's
not much we can do.
Well, this is it.
I'll stay here and keep an eye on the office.
Haruka, I believe I told you on the day we first met...
Dancing is about expressing your feelings.
Letting others see what's in your heart.

Go and enjoy your time onstage. That will bring you the
results you're looking for.
All right, let's go, kiddo.

(The results of the first two rounds will be added to
today's final round score.)

(I won the first two rounds, so I'm going in with the
advantage. I can't let it go to waste!)

(I won one round, and they won the other, so neither one of
us has the advantage. I have to put everything I have into
this final round!)

(I haven't won a single round, so I'll be coming in from way
behind today.)

(I'll have to give the performance of a lifetime if I want
to pull this off!)
Hey, lookin' pretty good out there.
You got 3,500 experience points.
I think you're finally ready.
I agree. You've taken in everything we've taught you, Haruka.

Park-san certainly knew what she was doing when she chose
you.
You really think so...? Thank you!
By the way, where's Akiyama-san today?
Ah, been on your mind, has he, Yamaura? He's a handsome one, isn't he?
What!? It's nothin' like that.
Akiyama-san's... at Osaka Talent.
What!? What's he doing there!?
He wants to talk to their president.

Well, never mind that right now, Yamaura. We have
preparations to make, do we not?

Yeah, you're right. We'll be in the office, so come on down
once ya get changed.

Not your best, kiddo. Okay, take a break, and we'll do it
again.
Come see me when you're ready.

Mornin', Haruka. Let's get right to it. We'll do a full
rehearsal for the Princess League.

Let's raise the difficulty level this time. If you can't
handle this, there's no way you'll be able to beat T-Set.
It's time to grin and bear it, Haruka.

Win this, and your talent will be recognized by everyone.
But if you lose...

Then this agency's done for. And let's be honest, they'd
never let you shine over at Osaka Talent.
That's the life of a star. One mistake, and it's all over.

In a sense, you're lucky that you get to experience this
kind of urgency before making your big debut.
Well, we can start anytime. You ready?
I'm sorry. I'm not ready just yet.
Okay, I'll be waitin' here. Do what ya need to do.
Okay, then! Here we go!
Oh, Haruka. Akiyama-san.
Akiyama-san said he'd like to talk to us.
Both of us?
That's right. It's about this agency.
I wanted you to hear this, too, Yamaura-san.
So, what did you want to tell us?
I found Park-san's account book.

We thought the money I loaned Park-san had disappeared from
the safe, but it turns out that wasn't the case.
Looking through the account book, I found out the money had already been spent.
Park-san was sure Haruka-chan would win the Princess League.

So sure, in fact, that she arranged Haruka-chan's big debut
in advance.

Yes, I knew about that. Park-san had been talking about
Haruka doing a concert in Tokyo for a long time.

Hang on, there's more. You haven't heard where she wanted to
have it.
I think, once you hear, you'll understand why it cost three hundred million.
She reserved⑬get this⑬the Japan Dome.
What!? The Japan Dome? For a new kid's debut!?
How on earth was she planning to fill that many seats!?
Knowing Park-san, she probably had an idea or two.
But I guess now we'll never know.
No wonder Park-san wouldn't tell me the venue!
The Japan Dome!? It's absurd!

I think it was important to Park-san that the concert be at
the Japan Dome.
Because she told me...

Park-san almost got to perform at the Japan Dome back when
she was an idol herself.

I get the feeling all her hopes and dreams revolved around
that place.
Haruka-chan, what about you? What do you want to do?
If the Japan Dome is what Park-san wanted for my debut...
Then, that's where I have to have it.
As her last idol, I'm the only one who can carry on Mirei Park's dream.
Okay, but without Park-san or Horie-kun, what can we possibly do?
Dyna Chair still has you, Yamaura-san.

Me? I mean, sure, I can handle filling in as her manager,
but that's about it. I could never put together a concert.
I don't have that kind of expertise.
You're forgetting about me.

I have quite a bit of experience running even bigger
concerts overseas.
I'll help you organize it.

Besides, what kind of professional would I be if I didn't
see my job through to the end?
And right now my job is seeing that Haruka becomes a top-ranked pop idol.

You really think we can pull it off? I mean, this is the
Japan Dome we're talkin' about.

If I know Park-san, she didn't stop at simply reserving the
venue.

I'm sure she already hired a full event staff as well. In
any case, it's certainly something you could look into.

Once we have an answer, we can decide if it's actually
doable or not.
Please, Yamaura-san.

All right, fine. Let me do some digging, then. I'll need a
little time, of course.
Akiyama-san, mind if I go over that account book?

Getting a look at those expenditures will help me know where
things are and who to call.
Park was wise to hire you, Yamaura.
Thank you, Yamaura-san.
Starting today, you're the boss of this agency.

Park-san would've liked that. I'm sure Horie-chan will be on
board, too.
Heh, thank you.

Haruka-chan, why not leave the rest to Yamaura-san and
Christina-san? You just get yourself ready.
I'm sure Park-san would have wanted it that way, don't you think?
...Thank you, Akiyama-san.

Whoops, there's the call. Haruka-chan, I bet this is our forger
friend in Kamurocho.
Is this Akiyama of Sky Finance?
This is he.
I got a call from your secretary. She asked me to call you.
You're the forger? The one from Kamurocho?
You have to ask? Now, what's this about? You have a job for me?

Well, I don't have a forging job for you, exactly, but I'll
pay you nonetheless.

I want you to hook me up with an Osaka forger⑬more
specifically, one in the Sotenbori vicinity.
What would you want with him?

I need him to forge a suicide note. I have a sample of the
handwriting.
In that case, I have somebody in mind.
So how can I get in touch?
Well, it's not like we're best buddies or anything.

But there's a little place called Crest Bar in Hoganji
Yokocho in Sotenbori.
You might try asking the bartender.
Thank you. My secretary will forward you the payment.

Crest Bar in Hoganji Yokocho⑬not a place for you,
Haruka-chan. And it's late, too. I'll be going this one
alone, all right?
Yes, I understand.

I'll be waiting here. Just let me know if there's anything I
can do.
I just wish Park-san and Horie-kun were here to see it too.

Park-san found a real star when she found you. I just know
you can make the Japan Dome event a success.

I believe you'll fulfill both your and Park-san's dreams.
I really do.

Oh, that's right. We left Christina back at the office,
didn't we?
We oughta head back and tell him the good news.
Okay, let's get goin'.

Well, Haruka, the results aren't exactly what we hoped for,
but, either way, great job.

Shame Park-san and Horie-kun couldn't be here to watch you
give it your all up there.

And don't forget. Park-san knew what she was doing when she
chose you.
I just know you can make the Japan Dome event a success.
We oughta head back and tell him how it went.
Okay, let's go, then.
Oh, yeah. That's good. That's real good.
Now I'm all embarrassed.
Don't worry 'bout that. All ya gotta think about now is your performance.
Excuse me, Sawamura-san. We're just about ready.
Hey, Haruka.
Once you leave this room, there's no turnin' back.
I know. It's my one and only chance.

That's not what I'm talkin' about. It's just... once you
walk through that door, you'll never be a regular girl ever again.
Listen to me, Haruka.

Whether ya win or lose today, your life as a normal high
school girl is over.
If ya win, you'll have your big debut.

And that means no matter where ya go, you'll have people's
eyes on you at all times.
And if ya lose, you'll have to live with that feelin' for the rest of your life.

People might sympathize with you for a while, but they might
start to feel contempt for ya, too.

You're damned if you win, damned if you lose. And you only
get to enjoy your victories for a little while. That's just
how it goes in the entertainment industry.
Knowing all that, are ya sure you still wanna pursue this dream of yours?

If your dream is really something else, now's your last
chance to change your mind.

What do you wanna do, Haruka? Are ya really ready to walk
out onto that stage for the final round?
Yes. I've made up my mind.
Yamaura-san... I...
Hesitant?

I'd like to see you go on, of course. That'd no doubt be the
best thing for the agency.

But I know how much you've been through just to get this
far, so I'll ask ya one more time.
Do you want to drop out of the final round?
Yes. I'm sure.
All right, I understand... especially now that Park-san is gone.

And this is your whole life we're talking about. Nobody can
say you're making the wrong choice.
I'm sorry, Yamaura-san.
Don't be. This is about you, and I respect your decision.
No. No, wait! I'll do it!

No matter how difficult things might get, I don't want to
live with the regret of not ever trying.
Park-san's dream is my dream now.
All right. In that case...

Haruka, get out there and bring us back a win on that final
round!
Unbelievable! Those little brats are the top idols in Osaka!?
I'm surprised their fans can't see right through 'em!
Haruka, don't you dare lose to those two! That's an order!
Put those girls to shame!
Shame? Well, I don't know about that...
But don't worry. I'll win. I have to!

That's right. For both Park-san and Horie-kun's sakes.
Okay, let's get to it. Time to change into your costume.
You did it, Haruka! Now all that's left is the final round!
You've come such a long way, kiddo.
I bet Park-san was right there watchin', too.
T-Set'll be fighting for their lives out there.
You'll have to give it everything you got, right to the very end!
What happened, Haruka? I know you can do better than that.

Oh well, nothin' we can do about it now. You just gotta try
extra hard in the final round.
This is bad, Haruka. T-Set's way ahead of you now.

The final round is next. It'll be your last chance to turn
this thing around. You can do it!
I can do it!

All right. Let's get back to Sotenbori. You're supposed to
meet Akiyama-san, right?
Well, just don't go overboard.

To be honest, I'd rather see ya spendin' your extra time on
lessons and the like.

Christina and I will be standin' by, so come see us anytime,
ya hear?
Yes. Thank you.
Well, would ya look at you! You look absolutely fantastic!
Why did you make a promise like that!?
Didn't Horie-kun tell ya to stay away from 'em?
I'm sorry. I just couldn't keep quiet any longer.
Yeah, I'll bet he was countin' on that. That's how he operates.

Well, that's okay. All you gotta do is trounce 'em and
that'll be the end of it.

I know you can do it. Take that T-Set down a peg, and you'll
be the top idol in Osaka!
